{
  "process": "One row represents a loan application that was approved and listed on Lending Club. The sequence: borrower applies with personal/financial info, credit report is pulled, underwriting assigns grade/interest rate, loan is listed for funding, investors commit funds, loan is issued, borrower makes payments, and finally the loan resolves (fully paid, charged off, etc.).",
  "target_known_at": "loan resolution (when final status is determined, e.g., fully paid or charged off)",
  "prediction_point": "at the time the loan is listed for funding, before any investor commitments",
  "columns": [
    {"name": "emp_length", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "delinq_2yrs", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "pub_rec_bankruptcies", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "loan_amnt", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "funded_amnt", "event": "funding completion", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "pub_rec", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "grade", "event": "underwriting", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "home_ownership", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "revol_bal", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "inq_last_6mths", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "dti", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "mths_since_last_record", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "mths_since_last_delinq", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "total_acc", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "annual_inc", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "sub_grade", "event": "underwriting", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "int_rate", "event": "underwriting", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "recoveries", "event": "post-charge-off collections", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "earliest_cr_line", "event": "credit report pull", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "installment", "event": "calculated from loan_amnt, int_rate, term at listing", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 0.9},
    {"name": "addr_state", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "funded_amnt_inv", "event": "funding completion", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "verification_status", "event": "underwriting", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "issue_d", "event": "loan issuance", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "term", "event": "application", "verdict": "AVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
    {"name": "collection_recovery_fee", "event": "post-charge-off collections", "verdict": "UNAVAILABLE", "confidence": 1.0},
